volunteer.summary: Supported resident care and well-being within a long-term elder-care environment while gaining experience in communication, teamwork, and healthcare services.
highlights: Assisted with resident care by monitoring needs and supporting daily well-being
Developed communication and interpersonal skills through interactions with residents and healthcare staff
Strengthened time management and teamwork skills in a clinical setting
Gained insight into elder-care practices and the psychological needs of aging populations

awards.title: Manoa Academic Merit Scholarship
